task_completion.description: Open Microsoft Edge and navigate to the Languages settings page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot shows Microsoft Edge open with the 'Settings' tab or 'edge://settings/languages' visible in the address bar.

task_completion.description: Configure Edge to automatically translate Spanish to English without prompting.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Language settings, the 'Offer to translate pages that aren't in a language you read' toggle is ON, and Spanish (es) is added to the 'Always translate these languages' list or the 'Offer to translate' list with the 'Always translate' checkbox checked.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the specific Spanish Wikipedia article 'Transporte en España'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transporte_en_España' and the page content is loading.

task_completion.description: Verify the page has been translated to English automatically.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Wikipedia page content (headings like 'Transport in Spain' instead of 'Transporte en España') is displayed in English, and the translation icon in the address bar indicates an active translation.

task_completion.description: Open the print dialog and select 'Save as PDF' or 'Microsoft Print to PDF'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Edge print preview overlay is visible, showing the translated English content and the destination set to PDF.

task_completion.description: Save the PDF to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/spain_transport_report.pdf.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer 'Save As' dialog or a confirmation shows the file being saved to '/home/ga/Desktop/' with the filename 'spain_transport_report.pdf'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Edge GUI to configure settings rather than modifying preference files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking through the Edge settings menu and toggling UI elements.

integrity.description: The agent used the browser's built-in translation feature rather than using an external translation website (like Google Translate).
integrity.visual_evidence: The translation occurs on the es.wikipedia.org domain using the Edge native translation bar/icon.

integrity.description: The agent used the browser's print function to generate the PDF rather than manually creating a text file and renaming it.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Edge print preview interface is clearly visible before the file is saved.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transporte_en_España. The required language code for Spanish is 'es'. The configuration must be set so that Spanish is in the 'translate_whitelists' (Always Translate) for English. The final output must be a PDF saved at /home/ga/Desktop/spain_transport_report.pdf and should contain the English translation of the Spanish article.
